analysis.title: Accelevation Holdings (ACCV): 3Q26 First Take: 3Q beat, 4Q guide in line
key_insights: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA was $37.7mn vs GS estimate $35.0mn and FactSet consensus $34.1mn, a beat driven by stronger-than-expected sales.
3Q26 revenue was $202.2mn, +65.9% y/y vs GS estimate $194.7mn (+59.7% y/y) and FactSet $192.4mn. Total organic growth was +66% vs GS +60%.
Book-to-bill in the quarter was 3.9x with bookings +364% y/y. Backlog is $1.7bn, +329% y/y, which GS says gives visibility through the rest of this year and into next year.
ACCV initiated FY26 guidance of revenue $905-915mn (vs GS $903mn / cons $898mn) and adjusted EBITDA $155-165mn (vs GS $158mn / cons $156mn).
Implied 4Q26 revenue is $265-275mn (cons $269mn) and adjusted EBITDA $49-59mn (cons $54mn), both in line with consensus.
GS views the result as better than expected given robust orders and backlog, but against low expectations: the stock is down 32% since the IPO.

GS expects the shares to be driven by 4Q26 order trends and commentary on incremental margins. 3Q26 incremental margin was 11.0% vs GS estimate 4.2%, while adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 18.6% from 23.7% a year earlier.
GS Buy rating and $22 12-month price target (based on 13.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA) vs $12.21 close on 12 Nov 2026, implying 80.2% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA beat and FY26 guide above GS and consensus on revenue and EBITDA. Backlog of $1.7bn (+329% y/y) and book-to-bill of 3.9x support the 13.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA target.

FY26 company guidance initiated: revenue $905-915mn and adjusted EBITDA $155-165mn, vs GS estimates $903mn/$158mn and consensus $898mn/$156mn.
